تبتدهون (form VIII)
# تَبْتَدِهُونَ (tabtadihūna) /tab.ta.di.huː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَدَهَ (ibtadaha)
# تُبْتَدَهُونَ (tubtadahūna) /tub.ta.da.huː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَدَهَ (ibtadaha)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
